This document describes the best practices for identifying the language and direction for strings used on the Web.

Introduction

Strings on the Web carry language and direction metadata.

Best practices and recommendations

Producers should supply language and direction metadata for each string.

Language and direction unknown

When the language and direction of a string are unknown, omit the metadata and let consumers apply defaults.

Use cases

Use cases include JSON payloads, WebIDL dictionaries, and other string-based data formats.
